messages.text: Your refund proposal is for BRL 93.50. Please confirm it using the button on the proposal card; replying “yes” here won’t confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member will review the request.

The customer confirmed request prop-3906f05f8d9844db, but a staff member rejected it, so nothing will be paid. The staff member gave this reason for the customer: "The returned bag has a stain on the strap."
Your refund request was rejected because the returned bag has a stain on the strap. No refund will be paid.
I never used the bag; I only took it out of the box. I don’t accept this decision. Could I speak to a person?
